name: Keystones
description: The keystones are powerful artifacts that require careful stewardship. The current party has become a new generation of guardians rather than simple keepers, and each assigned member now bears responsibility for protecting a keystone. Unlike previous keepers who merely hid the keystones, guardians are expected to actively develop and protect their assigned realms. The lich continues to seek the keystones.

log.summary: The current party has become a new generation of **guardians** rather than simple keepers of the keystones. Where past keepers were expected merely to hide and preserve these artifacts, guardians are charged with actively developing and protecting their assigned realms. Each party member who received a keystone now bears personal responsibility for its protection and stewardship. The keystones remain powerful artifacts that demand careful handling, and the ongoing threat persists as the lich continues to seek them.
